stem: Unlike other rap artists, who often ____ behind the microphone, Drake writes out every word of his rhymes before he performs them.
The employees' blithe natures were in sharp contrast to the ____ disposition of their manager.
What is especially (i)____ about the company's fiscal situation is that everybody knows the grim facts and (ii)____ the implications, but nobody is willing to take any action to improve matters.

Researchers claim that early mammals evolved a multistep process to synthesize vitamin C in their own bodies but that tens of millions of years ago some primates became so (i)____ eating fruits rich in this vitamin that making their own became (ii)____. Their physiology (iii)____ their behavior. Consequently, their descendants, today's anthropoid primates, cannot make vitamin C.
Computational psychologists, since they take the operation of a computer as a model, ____ concepts from computer science to explain what the mind is and how it works.

The late nineteenth century saw a shift in the production of African American history writing as works by ____ authors came to be outnumbered by the publications of professional African American academics.
There is a ____ in the author’s writing: the words seem to stand almost in defiance of one another.
